_comment: LEVEL 4 (component): signed webhook delivery — HMAC signature so receivers can verify authenticity.
name: comp-webhook-sender
description: Webhook sender: HMAC-signed JSON delivery with retry + backoff. Import: from {{ utils_dir }}.webhook import send_webhook, verify_signature

variables.name: default_secret_env
variables.description: Env var holding the shared HMAC secret

notes: Usage: send_webhook(url, {'event': 'user.created', 'id': 1}). Receivers verify with verify_signature(body, sig, secret). Set WEBHOOK_SECRET in .env. Stdlib only — no requests dependency.
